notes: Each day phrase writes two article morphemes and the ASV one the, so the noun's article takes it and the ordinal's agreement article is unrepresented under rule 47.
The two later temporal phrases carry a bet the ASV renders as a bare adverbial, so those prepositions are unrepresented under rule 40.
The apodosis then rests on the waw of u-va-yom, a conjunction being present to carry it (rule 14).
bo fuses as therewith under rule 22's closing sentence, headed on the preposition since no relative stands.
